detailed_results.correct_independent: Perform an impairment test; if recoverable amount is below carrying amount, recognize an impairment loss

Under IAS 7 and ASC 230, proceeds from sale of PPE are classified as investing activities — disposal of long-term assets.
A continuous (rolling) budget adds a new period as the current period ends. 12-quarter rolling budget = continuous budget.

Cash available = $34,000 + $412,000 − $398,000 = $48,000. Since $48,000 > $30,000 minimum, no borrowing triggered. Ending cash = $48,000. Verified.

detailed_results.correct_independent: Top-down budgets can be faster but may lack buy-in; participative budgets improve motivation but may introduce slack

Sales volume variance: $44 × (23,100 − 22,000) = $44 × 1,100 = $48,400 favorable. Verified.
Employee training hours and system upgrade completion rates measure human capital and information capital — foundational infrastructure of the learning and growth perspective.
Equivalent units (conversion): 8,000 × 60% = 4,800. Verified.
Activity rate: $312,000 ÷ 6,500 = $48/hr. Cost assigned: $48 × 340 = $16,320. Verified.
Incoming materials inspection detects defects — textbook appraisal cost. Prevention prevents, appraisal detects.
Designing quality into processes = prevention. TQM/lean philosophy emphasizes 'building quality in' rather than 'inspecting quality in.'
Reciprocal method uses simultaneous equations to capture mutual services between departments. Most theoretically precise.

detailed_results.correct_stored: Control environment, risk assessment, control activities, information and communication, monitoring
detailed_results.correct_independent: Control environment, risk assessment, control activities, information and communication, monitoring
detailed_results.notes: COSO 2013 five components correctly listed.
Integrity, ethical values, and commitment to competence = Control Environment (tone at the top).
Periodic management reviews and deficiency follow-up = Monitoring Activities (ongoing monitoring + separate evaluations).

detailed_results.correct_stored: Incentive or pressure, opportunity, and rationalization
detailed_results.correct_independent: Incentive or pressure, opportunity, and rationalization
detailed_results.notes: Fraud triangle = incentive/pressure, opportunity, rationalization. 'Motive, means, opportunity' is a common distractor but not the fraud triangle.

detailed_results.correct_stored: Independence and objectivity of the internal audit function
detailed_results.correct_independent: Independence and objectivity of the internal audit function
detailed_results.notes: IIA standards: internal audit reporting to audit committee ensures structural independence from management.
Why did returns increase? = diagnostic analytics (root cause analysis). Descriptive = what happened, predictive = what will happen, prescriptive = what to do.

detailed_results.correct_stored: Requirements analysis, design, configuration, testing, implementation, maintenance
detailed_results.correct_independent: Requirements analysis, design, configuration, testing, implementation, maintenance
detailed_results.notes: Standard SDLC phases correctly sequenced. Distractors are financial statement elements, cost classifications, and management cycle phases.
RPA = rules-based, repetitive, high-volume tasks with structured data. AP tasks (invoice matching, data entry) = classic RPA use case.

detailed_results.correct_stored: Data governance with master data management and standard definitions
detailed_results.correct_independent: Data governance with master data management and standard definitions
detailed_results.notes: Inconsistent customer data across systems = master data management problem. Data governance establishes single source of truth.

detailed_results.correct_stored: Multi-factor authentication and periodic access reviews
detailed_results.correct_independent: Multi-factor authentication and periodic access reviews
detailed_results.notes: MFA + access reviews = strongest access control. Shared passwords, full access, and disabling logs all weaken security.

detailed_results.correct_stored: FIFO results in higher net income and higher ending inventory
detailed_results.correct_independent: FIFO results in higher net income and higher ending inventory
detailed_results.notes: In rising prices: FIFO → oldest (cheapest) costs to COGS → lower COGS → higher NI. Newest (highest) costs in ending inventory → higher EI. Correct.
ASC 715: Interest cost = beginning PBO × discount rate. Accretion of obligation due to time passage. Service cost = new benefits earned.

detailed_results.correct_stored: A finance lease with a right-of-use asset and lease liability recognized
detailed_results.correct_independent: A finance lease with a right-of-use asset and lease liability recognized
detailed_results.notes: IFRS 16: lessee recognizes ROU asset and lease liability for all leases with limited exceptions. 'Capital lease' is pre-IFRS 16 terminology (ASC 840).

detailed_results.correct_stored: Recognize revenue over time as the services are provided
detailed_results.correct_independent: Recognize revenue over time as the services are provided
detailed_results.notes: IFRS 15: customer simultaneously receives and consumes benefits → performance obligation satisfied over time → revenue recognized over time.
ZBB = justify every expense from scratch each cycle. Distinct from incremental (adjust prior year), kaizen (continuous improvement), and continuous (rolling horizon).
Consistent percentage reduction from cumulative experience = learning curve. Moving average = time-series, regression = statistical relationship, Monte Carlo = simulation.

detailed_results.correct_stored: Specific measurable objectives, action plans, and resource allocations to achieve the strategic goal
detailed_results.correct_independent: Specific measurable objectives, action plans, and resource allocations to achieve the strategic goal
detailed_results.notes: Operating budget operationalizes strategy — translating a 15% market share goal into specific objectives, action plans, and resource allocations.
ROI: $180,000 ÷ $900,000 = 0.20 = 20.0%. Exceeds required return of 12%. Verified.
Market-based TP preserves divisional autonomy by using external market as objective benchmark. Full-cost can pass on inefficiencies; variable-cost penalizes selling division.

Budgeted weighted CM: ($85 × 0.60) + ($65 × 0.40) = $51 + $26 = $77. Actual weighted CM: ($85 × 0.55) + ($65 × 0.45) = $46.75 + $29.25 = $76. Mix variance: ($76 − $77) × 10,000 = −$10,000 = $10,000 unfavorable. Shift from higher-CM alarms to lower-CM cameras. Verified.

Customer satisfaction score is clearly customer perspective. On-time delivery and defect rate have dual classification (internal process AND customer-facing). The explanation correctly addresses this nuance — framing them as customer-experience indicators. Reasonable classification, no error.

detailed_results.correct_stored: Segment margin deducts direct fixed costs, giving a more complete picture of a segment's profitability
detailed_results.correct_independent: Segment margin deducts direct fixed costs, giving a more complete picture of a segment's profitability
detailed_results.notes: Segment margin = CM − direct/traceable fixed costs. Better measure than contribution margin for segment profitability evaluation.
Target cost = market price − required margin. $400 − 25% → max allowable cost. Classic target costing approach.

detailed_results.correct_stored: Pull-based production that produces only what is needed when it is needed
detailed_results.correct_independent: Pull-based production that produces only what is needed when it is needed
detailed_results.notes: JIT = demand-pull, minimal inventory, small batches, quality at source. High inventory, end-of-line inspection, and large batches are anti-JIT.

detailed_results.correct_stored: Consider interdependencies across all activities rather than minimizing each activity independently
detailed_results.correct_independent: Consider interdependencies across all activities rather than minimizing each activity independently
detailed_results.notes: Porter's value chain: activities are linked; optimizing one in isolation can suboptimize the whole. Eliminating R&D to cut costs is a textbook example of suboptimization.

Prevention: $25,000 (training). Appraisal: $55,000 (inspection). Total prevention + appraisal = $80,000. Rework ($38,000) = internal failure; warranty ($72,000) = external failure — excluded from conformance costs. Verified.

detailed_results.correct_stored: Implement controls to reduce risk, transfer through insurance, or accept if cost of control exceeds benefit
detailed_results.correct_independent: Implement controls to reduce risk, transfer through insurance, or accept if cost of control exceeds benefit
detailed_results.notes: COSO ERM: remote-likelihood/severe-impact risks warrant layered response — reduce (controls), share (insurance), accept (residual after cost-benefit). Absolute avoidance or ignoring is disproportionate.

detailed_results.correct_stored: The same employee can create a purchase order, receive goods, and approve payment
detailed_results.correct_independent: The same employee can create a purchase order, receive goods, and approve payment
detailed_results.notes: Segregation of duties: authorization (PO), custody (receiving), and recordkeeping/payment (approval) must be separated. All other options describe proper controls.

detailed_results.correct_stored: User access management and program change controls
detailed_results.correct_independent: User access management and program change controls
detailed_results.notes: ITGCs = system-wide controls (access management, change controls, operations). Application controls = transaction-specific (input validation, 3-way match, exception reports).

detailed_results.correct_stored: Process owners evaluate control effectiveness and identify improvement opportunities
detailed_results.correct_independent: Process owners evaluate control effectiveness and identify improvement opportunities
detailed_results.notes: CSA = control self-assessment by process owners. Complements (doesn't replace) other monitoring activities. Management, not auditors, owns internal control.

COSO: communicating control responsibilities and policies = Information and Communication component. Not control environment (tone), control activities (procedures), or risk assessment (identification).
Data warehouse = centralized repository for structured, processed data optimized for reporting/analysis. Data lake = raw data. GL = source system, not analytical repository.

detailed_results.correct_stored: Data mining with anomaly detection algorithms
detailed_results.correct_independent: Data mining with anomaly detection algorithms
detailed_results.notes: Fraud detection = data mining + anomaly detection. Simple ratios or manual spreadsheet review cannot detect subtle/non-obvious patterns at scale.
Configuring user roles and permissions = Design and Configuration phase of SDLC. Follows requirements analysis, precedes testing.

detailed_results.correct_stored: A balanced set of performance indicators incorporating efficiency, quality, and cost
detailed_results.correct_independent: A balanced set of performance indicators incorporating efficiency, quality, and cost
detailed_results.notes: Production yield (efficiency) + on-time delivery (quality) + cost per unit (cost) = balanced dashboard across multiple performance dimensions.
GDPR governs EU personal data. FASB = accounting standards, SOX = financial reporting/internal controls, COSO = control framework (not binding regulation).

detailed_results.correct_stored: Recognize $500,000 as goodwill and test for impairment annually
detailed_results.correct_independent: Recognize $500,000 as goodwill and test for impairment annually
detailed_results.notes: ASC 805/IFRS 3: $3,200,000 − $2,700,000 = $500,000 goodwill. Goodwill is not amortized; tested for impairment at least annually. Bargain purchase only when FV of net assets > consideration.

detailed_results.correct_independent: Recognize a deferred tax asset of $11,750
detailed_results.notes: Temporary difference: $145,000 − $98,000 = $47,000 deductible. DTA: $47,000 × 25% = $11,750. Future tax deduction → deferred tax asset. Verified.

ASC 250/IAS 8: voluntary change in accounting principle (FIFO → weighted average) = retrospective application. Prospective = changes in estimates only.

detailed_results.correct_stored: The master budget process flowing from the sales budget
detailed_results.correct_independent: The master budget process flowing from the sales budget
detailed_results.notes: Master budget begins with sales budget → production → DM/DL/OH → budgeted financial statements. Sales-driven sequencing is fundamental.
Kaizen = continuous improvement targets embedded in budget. 3% quarterly waste reduction = explicit improvement target, not ZBB (from-scratch justification) or incremental (prior-year adjustment).
$75,000 × $0.40 = $30,000 maximum reduction in repair costs. Simple proportional cost-benefit. Verified.

VOH spending variance: $76,585 − ($6.50 × 11,900) = $76,585 − $77,350 = −$765 = $765 favorable. Actual spending below standard at actual hours → favorable. Verified.

EVA = NOPAT − (capital × WACC). Charges for cost of equity capital, aligning management with long-term shareholder value. Variance-based metrics are short-term, single-period measures.
